description: Check once, without waiting, on a jobId that a generation tool returned instead of an asset after its 30s wait. Free. Returns asset URLs when complete, the failure reason if it failed, or the current state and job age if still running. Campaign ids go to pixeldojo_campaign_status; films report progress through pixeldojo_film with action "status".

jobId.description: The jobId a generation tool returned instead of an asset (a job_... id).

name: pixeldojo_status
title: Check job status
